info.name: List all contacts for an organization

params.name: orgId
params.description:
engageSPARK ID of the organization.
You can find this ID in your [Organization Profile](https://app.engagespark.com/organization/info).

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to retrieve.

params.name: size
params.description: The requested number of items on a page.

params.name: search
params.description: Search term to filter contacts by name or phone number

params.name: phonenumber
params.description: Filter by international phone number (E164, with optional leading +). If "region" is given this should be a local phone number.

params.name: region
params.description: Used together with phonenumber, this is the country 2 letter name.

params.name: groupid
params.description: Filter by group ID

params.name: noautodelete
params.description: Filter by no-autodelete setting

params.name: whatsappready
params.description: Filter by contacts which have WhatsApp Business User ID set

params.name: conditions
params.description: JSON string of custom conditions for filtering see schema_condition.yaml

params.name: subscriptionstatus
params.description: Campaign ID to include subscription status information

params.name: subscriptionfilter
params.description: Filter by subscription status (requires subscriptionstatus parameter)

items.docs:
List all contacts for an organization, with optional filtering and pagination.

You can filter contacts by:
  - Search terms (searches names and phone numbers)
  - Group membership
  - Full phone number
  - Local phone number + Country
  - Custom conditions
  - Subscription status
  - No-autodelete setting
  - WhatsApp Business User ID set


Use the `subscriptionstatus` parameter to include subscription status information for a specific campaign. Use the `subscriptionfilter` parameter to filter

info.name: Create a new contact in the system

params.name: orgId
params.description:
engageSPARK ID of the organization.
You can find this ID in your [Organization Profile](https://app.engagespark.com/organization/info).

items.docs:
Add a new contact to the system. This will return a contact ID which can be used in other engageSPARK APIs.

Most APIs will create a contact on the fly when you use a new phone number, but creating it explicitly gives you more control over the contact fields (such as "first name").

Exactly one of "fullPhoneNumber", or "phoneNumber" with "phoneNumberCountry" needs to be set.

Using this API you can create multiple different contacts with the same phone number.
